overview.purpose_zh: 这张日历热力图用来看半年里每天的手机使用时间，重点是工作日和周末的节奏差别，以及哪些日子特别重、哪些日子特别轻。
works_zh: 适合看每天的小变化和固定的周节奏，而不是只看一条平均线
适合一眼找出最重的那几天和连续的低谷
uses_zh: 回顾自己的手机使用习惯，找出固定的高峰日
安排需要专注的任务时，避开注意力最短的日子

understanding.read_zh: 先把每一行当成一个星期，横向的七天从左到右排开；颜色越深，当天的分钟数越高，颜色越浅，时间越短。再看两类格子：靠边的周末格几乎总是更深，中间的工作日格连成一条颜色相近的带。最后看个别特别深的格子，它们往往出现在六月末的周末。

elements.note_zh: 一个格子就是一天，同一横行的格子属于同一周。
颜色越深，屏幕使用时间越长；颜色越浅，时间越短。
每周有两个固定的格子是周六和周日，它们通常明显更深。
每一横行是一周，横向看出一周里的起伏，纵向比较不同周。

look_for_zh: 先看有没有固定位置整列偏深，那就是周末
再看有没有连续几格特别深或特别浅，那是个别例外而不是规律

observations.en: Weekday cells stay between 84 and 114 minutes, while weekend cells run from 124 to 154, so the two bands never overlap.
observations.zh: 工作日的格子落在 84 到 114 分钟之间，周末的格子则从 124 到 154，两段从不重叠。

observations.en: The grid peaks at 154 minutes on June 7, and the quietest day is January 23 at 84.
observations.zh: 整张图的峰值出现在六月七日，为 154 分钟；最轻的一天是一月二十三日，只有 84 分钟。

observations.en: Only 10 minutes separate the busiest weekday, 114 on June 8, from the lightest weekend day, 124 on January 24.
observations.zh: 最忙的工作日是六月八日的 114 分钟，最轻的周末日是一月二十四日的 124 分钟，两者只差 10 分钟。

observations.en: The long-run movement is small: June 30 ends at 103 minutes, just 8 above the 95 recorded on January 1.
observations.zh: 长时间看变化很小：六月三十日收在 103 分钟，只比一月一日的 95 分钟高 8 分钟。

describe.en: The calendar heatmap shows daily screen time from January to June 2026, with one cell for each day and darker cells for longer use.
describe.zh: 这张日历热力图显示 2026 年一月到六月每天的手机使用时间，一天一个格子，用得越久颜色越深。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + over what period
alternatives: The calendar shows how many minutes were spent on the phone each day.
The chart covers every day from January to June 2026.
describe.note_zh: 开头交代每天一个格子、颜色代表分钟数，读者才知道深色是什么意思。

describe.en: Every weekend day is higher than the weekday beside it; January 24 reaches 124 minutes against 84 on January 23.
describe.zh: 每个周末日的使用时间都高于旁边的平日：一月二十四日达到 124 分钟，而一月二十三日只有 84 分钟。
describe.pattern: A is higher than B / higher than + figure
alternatives: Weekend values are consistently higher than weekday values.
January 24 at 124 is higher than January 23 at 84.
describe.note_zh: 比较两类日子时，各给一个代表值就够了，不必把每个周末都念一遍。

describe.en: Weekday values cluster between 84 and 114, and weekend values form a separate cluster between 124 and 154.
describe.zh: 工作日的数值集中在 84 到 114 之间，周末的数值则聚成另一团，落在 124 到 154 之间。
alternatives: The weekday readings cluster in a narrow band from 84 to 114.
Weekend readings sit in their own cluster, from 124 to 154.
describe.note_zh: cluster 说的是数值抱团，不是时间上的连续；这里正好两团，中间空出 10 分钟。

describe.en: Screen time peaked at 154 minutes on June 7, the highest cell in the six months.
describe.zh: 屏幕使用时间在六月七日达到峰值 154 分钟，是半年里最深的格子。
describe.pattern: peak at + value / peak in + period
alternatives: The highest value, 154, falls on June 7.
The series peaks at 154 in early June.
describe.note_zh: peak at 后面跟数值，peak in 后面跟时间段；这里两者都能用。

describe.en: Weekend screen time fluctuated between 124 and 154 across the six months, with no clear upward or downward trend.
describe.zh: 周末的屏幕使用时间在半年里于 124 到 154 之间波动，没有明显的上升或下降趋势。
alternatives: The weekend band moved between 124 and 154 from month to month.
describe.note_zh: fluctuate 强调来回上下；如果只是稳定在某个水平，用 remain stable。

describe.en: A typical weekday sits at approximately 100 minutes, while a typical weekend day sits at approximately 140.
describe.zh: 普通工作日大约 100 分钟，普通周末日大约 140 分钟。
alternatives: Weekdays are approximately 100 minutes; weekends are approximately 140.
Most weekdays fall at approximately 100 minutes.
describe.note_zh: approximately 后面跟一个接近的数，不要求精确；想更严谨时直接给区间，说 between 84 and 114。

academic.en: The calendar heatmap presents daily screen time over six months, from January 1 to June 30, 2026. Days are arranged in weekly rows, one cell per day, with darker shading assigned to higher values. Two clearly separated bands are visible across the whole period: weekday readings fall between 84 and 114 minutes, whereas weekend readings fall between 124 and 154 minutes. The lowest value, 84, is recorded on January 23, and the highest, 154, on June 7. The bands remain separate in every month; the only longer-term movement is a modest upward drift of 8 minutes between January 1 and June 30.
academic.zh: 这张日历热力图呈现 2026 年一月 1 日到六月 30 日这六个月的每日屏幕使用时间。日期按周排成一行行，一格一天，颜色越深表示数值越高。整个时期都能看到两条明显分开的带：工作日的读数在 84 到 114 分钟之间，周末的读数在 124 到 154 分钟之间。最低值 84 出现在一月 23 日，最高值 154 出现在六月 7 日。每个月这两条带都保持分开；唯一较长期的变化是一月 1 日到六月 30 日之间约 8 分钟的小幅上升。

business.en: Our screen-time picture is a weekly habit rather than a slow drift, and that gives us a clean planning signal. Weekdays run between 84 and 114 minutes, weekends between 124 and 154, and the two never converge. The heaviest day of the half-year is June 7 at 154 minutes; the lightest is January 23 at 84. For our app and our brand partners, the commercial meaning is plain: weekend attention is roughly 40 minutes longer each day. We should schedule launches, campaigns and paid pushes on Saturday and Sunday, when our audience is already on a screen.
business.zh: 我们看到的屏幕使用时间是一种每周重复的习惯，不是缓慢变化，这给了我们明确的规划信号。工作日是 84 到 114 分钟，周末是 124 到 154 分钟，两者始终不重合。半年里最重的一天是六月 7 日，154 分钟；最轻的是一月 23 日，84 分钟。对我们的应用和品牌合作方来说，商业含义很直接：周末每天的关注时间大约多 40 分钟。我们应该把发布、活动和付费投放安排在周六和周日，那时我们的用户本来就在看屏幕。

simple.en: This chart shows how long one person used a phone each day for six months. One square is one day, and darker squares mean more minutes. Weekdays are lighter, from 84 to 114 minutes. Weekends are darker, from 124 to 154. The heaviest day was June 7, with 154 minutes. The lightest was January 23, with 84 minutes. The same pattern shows up week after week. So next Saturday will probably look a lot like the last one.
simple.zh: 这张图显示一个人半年里每天用手机多久。一个方块是一天，颜色越深表示分钟数越多。工作日颜色浅一些，从 84 到 114 分钟。周末颜色深一些，从 124 到 154 分钟。最重的一天是六月 7 日，154 分钟。最轻的是一月 23 日，84 分钟。同样的规律一周又一周地出现。所以下个周六大概和上个周六差不多。

language_notes.body_zh: every day 分开写是「每一天」，在句子里作时间状语；everyday 连写是形容词，意思是「日常的」。这张图每天一个格子，说的是 every day；写成 everyday，意思就变成「普通的」。
examples: The grid has one cell for every day from January to June.
Checking the phone is an everyday habit, not a special one.

language_notes.title_en: The darker the cell, the higher the value
language_notes.body_zh: 「越……越……」用 the + 比较级, the + 比较级。日历图最适合这个句型：颜色越深，数值越高。两个 the 都不能省，比较级也要放在各自从句的开头。
examples: The darker the cell, the higher the screen time.
The darker the square, the more minutes it records.

language_notes.body_zh: 美式英语里，具体指某个周末用 on the weekend，泛指每个周末用 on weekends，两者都用 on。说「周末整体更长」时，用 on weekends 更自然。
examples: Screen time rises on the weekend.
On weekends, the cells are always darker.
